scope.basis: Independent comparison of full detail fields against list/meta snapshots; no online verification or recollection.

original_files_unchanged.statement: No original meta/news/clue/social/detail snapshot, source CSV, raw record, content or source version was edited. Only research metadata, its builder/tests and this report changed.

changes: Narrow profile paths to structural segments; news/events/reports take precedence over about/profile prefixes.
Preserve microseconds when present; current recovered source dates remain unchanged.
Escape HTML-sensitive characters and Unicode separators in generated JS without changing decoded source strings.
Add fingerprints.original and fingerprints.translation for exact complete detail body strings, including whitespace and placeholders; additive schema 1.

publication_checks.provided_semantics: Provided means parseable original field, not independently verified publication/event semantics. Future-to-observation values are retained, never auto-corrected.
publication_checks.recovered_verified_semantics: Verified means matching top-level post date, ID and URL inside this snapshot; no live source authenticity check is claimed.
publication_checks.precision_note: Facebook .000Z becomes seconds at the same instant and raw values remain; all LinkedIn millisecond strings remain exact. Date-only fixtures stay date-only; microseconds are retained.
publication_checks.attribution_limitation: Catalog organization/account is collection scope and may differ from actual post author; identity validation does not prove institutional authorship.

translation_checks.claim_limit: Available means nonempty non-placeholder text, not verified translation accuracy or paragraph alignment.

official_version_groups.claim_limit: Different extracted bodies at one URL are candidates. HTML listings may be dynamic; PDF differences may be extraction differences. Remote revisions and chronological edit history were not verified.

coverage_checks.denominator_formula: 20 institutions * (3 angle totals + 3 social platform subtotals) = 120 cells
coverage_checks.overlap_warning: Social platform cells subdivide social angle cells; adding all 120 counts double-counts social records.
coverage_checks.denominator_limit: This matrix is not all expected accounts, URL entries, days or collection attempts. Zero observations do not prove absence or failure.

safety_checks.scope_limit: Isolated offline malicious-string fixture; not a complete audit of all application sinks or concurrent UI changes.

doc_type_checks.limitation: A people section may contain news rather than a biography; URL/title candidates are not confirmed types. No event dates or entities are inferred.

integration_notice.message: Schema 1 additive fulltext fingerprints.original/translation are now populated for 6989/6989. Use research-metadata-3 / a8acd9d0b712fbe06a65 for final UI and backend ingest. Preserve source version and original query semantics; handle older index-only baselines as comparison capability changes.

limitations: Evidence boundary is the existing complete static snapshot; no mounted CSV or live sources were accessed.
Internal consistency does not independently prove platform authenticity, timezone accuracy beyond stated offsets or institutional authorship.
Original provided dates can describe future events or extraction choices; retained as provided, not verified.
Translation status does not certify accuracy, language or paragraph alignment.
Source hash algorithm remains unspecified; derived SHA-256 applies to UTF-8 snapshot body strings, not remote files.
Original paths are evidence fields only; corresponding manifest/object accessibility was not tested.
Version/related groups are review candidates; they establish no event, partnership, cause, remote revision or monitoring claim.
Coverage lacks a target source roster, cadence and collection window, so missed collection rates cannot be computed.
Concurrent UI/backend changes are outside module ownership; browser validation covers the inspected escaping function only.

fingerprint_update.scope: Exact complete fields in stored detail snapshots. No truncation, whitespace trimming, newline normalization, titles or remote resource bytes.
fingerprint_update.missing_value_policy: Hash empty string when field is absent/null; status and availability remain separate.
fingerprint_update.baseline_transition_note: A saved baseline originally built from index-only values cannot retrospectively prove historical full-body differences. UI must label or re-establish the fingerprint baseline instead of presenting the capability upgrade as source edits.
fingerprint_update.backend_notice: Final ingest should use research-metadata-3 / a8acd9d0b712fbe06a65; v2 lacked complete-body fingerprints.
